summary: Nightly primary-source and absence-check firing. The primary-source lift (B16) had no reachable medium record left: every medium or low record above not_started or diverged already carries a lift review dated 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-18, and the seven older ones rest on hosts that refused fetches again on 2026-10-19 (dhs.gov, state.gov, media.defense.gov); the govinfo.gov text of P.L. 119-60 is still cut at about 128,000 characters even when read in parts. The firing therefore ran the systematic absence checks (B17) with the Unified Agenda route newly reachable: the reginfo.gov agency rule lists (labeled Agency Rule List - 2026, publication id 202510) were read for every absence-based record below 70 confidence, 104 records in all, 14 of them with all five checks run fresh and 90 with the agenda check added to the four checks documented on 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-18; nine research passes and five independent reviews, about 43 of 200 searches. Two stage changes: c20-16 not_started 0 to implemented 75 (VA statement to Congress of 2026-06-24 and VA staff office pages show the human resources and the operations, security and preparedness offices separated under their own Assistant Secretaries) and c14-42 not_started 0 to blocked 30, partial match (the 2027 Payment Notice non-network plan standard at 45 CFR 156.236, stayed by the District of Maryland on 2026-07-16). The standing watch list added c18-12, whose Wagner-Peyser staffing rule took effect 2026-10-19 with no court order found, moved from in_progress 55 to implemented 80, and confirmed publication of the National Park Service Alaska rule (c16-08, 91 FR 65985, effective 2026-11-18, stage unchanged). Confidence rose on 93 records and fell on 1 (c18-12, 85 to 78, because the rule's amendatory text could not be read in any rendition); 14 records moved from low to medium and 2 reached 70 or more (c20-16, c19-18). Reviewers held most absence records at 57 to 68 because the recommended action (legislation, an executive order, an office move, a designation) would not appear in a rulemaking agenda, so the agenda check is weakly informative for them. Counts after this run: implemented 109, in_progress 209, proposed 161, not_started 89, diverged 36, blocked 17, completed 6 of 627 counted.
title: Primary-source lift and systematic absence checks, early firing of 2026-10-19
